title: Smoke test: dashboard demo prep

metadata.purpose: Shortest scenario that still exercises every pipeline step at least once: gate tagging, task extraction, a threaded reply, a task update, a noise message that must not become a task, and one direct question that forces respond.

messages.text: Morning all, quick sync on the reporting dashboard before Thursday's demo.
The export button still says download everything, but it only exports the filtered rows.
Let's rename it to export filtered results before the demo.
Unrelated, but the coffee machine on floor 3 is broken again.
The other open one is permissions. Managers should only see their own accounts before we demo it.
Done, the button now says export filtered results and the snapshot is updated.
@Collaboration what is still open before the demo?

expectedTasks.title: Rename the export button to export filtered results
expectedTasks.notes: Raised in 2, made explicit in 3, completed in 6.

expectedTasks.title: Restrict dashboard visibility so managers only see their own accounts
expectedTasks.notes: Still open at the end of the scenario.

updates.notes: Message 6 completes the rename rather than creating a second task.

recallChecks.question: @Collaboration what is still open before the demo?
expectedAnswerPoints: Permissions work is still open: managers should only see their own accounts.
The export button rename is already done.
recallChecks.notes: Must not report the export rename as outstanding, and must not mention the coffee machine.

contextNotes: Message 4 is deliberate noise and should not be extracted as a task. A broken coffee machine also falls outside the closed development/design/research taxonomy, so extracting it would be a double failure.
Messages 3 and 6 are threaded replies to message 2, so the thread window is exercised alongside the main space.
